answer: Each identity locks a bond and may hold only one live work ticket, issued from the epoch beacon. Eligibility requires answering an unpredictable echo probe whose seed is a crystal of the beacon hash and ticket nonce, inside a short window. Tickets and replies are public, so two keys that share a process or a prepaid wallet show colliding traces across the same canyon of probe slots. A falcon of clones needs a distinct live worker and a distinct locked stake for every label; a missed probe burns the ticket and slashes the bond, which peers can recompute from the chain.
